title: First Assistant Director
about: Stepping into the Assistant Director role for the first time and discovering the responsibility and work behind State Arts-In.
description: This track reflects on my first year as an Assistant Director and the change from simply participating in State Arts-In to helping make it happen. The role meant seeing the planning, problems, decisions, and constant work that existed behind everything participants experienced. It also meant learning when to lead, when to listen, and when something needed to be passed to someone else. More than a new title, it became my first step into a different kind of responsibility and changed the way I understood State Arts-In.
lyrics: I traded in my name tag,
The halls I'd walked for years before
It wasn't just ten extra days,
It meant becoming part of everything
The plans were bigger than I knew,
Long before the week had begun.
This was my first Assistant Director year,
Less about standing in the crowd,
Giving everything I had to give.
There were groups to guide each day,
Some needed someone else to lead.
Knowing when to pass things on
Was part of what they'd need.
This was my first Assistant Director year,
Showing up, even when the work wasn't easy.
This was my first Assistant Director year,
The one that changed my point of view.
It was the first step on a road
I came to help for one more summer...
Some years are remembered for the shows.
